answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashable escrow. Each agent locks a meaningful token bond into a shared grove of validator contracts before it may earn fees in the meadow of the open market. Misbehavior such as duplicated claims triggers automatic slashing, so a sybil attacker spinning up thousands of fake agents must lock capital for every identity; losing even a sonnet-worth of microattacks forfeits each bond. Fake identities stop scaling profitably because each new puppet costs real money at risk, while honest agents recover their stake after clean attestations.
